children: Netskope Inc reported results for the second quarter ended July 31, 2026, with revenue of $220.5M, up 29% year-over-year, and a net loss attributable to common stockholders of $(110.8)M. Diluted loss per share was $(0.27) for the quarter.
Revenue: $220.5M for Q2 ended July 31, 2026, compared with $170.8M in the year-ago quarter; YoY change 29%.
Net income: Net loss attributable to common stockholders of $(110.8)M for Q2 ended July 31, 2026, vs. $(90.3)M in the year-ago quarter.
Diluted EPS: Loss per share, basic and diluted, $(0.27) for Q2 ended July 31, 2026, compared with $(0.84) in the year-ago quarter.
Revenue growth was balanced roughly 50/50 between new customer additions and expansion within existing customers, with revenue up 29% for the quarter and for the first six months of the year.
Continued investments in sales, marketing and channel partnerships, including a FedRAMP High win to pursue the U.S. federal market.
Product momentum around Netskope One across more than 25 products, emphasizing cloud- and AI-native security and platform extensibility.
Operational scale expanded: NewEdge global private cloud now covers 80+ regions and 200+ zones; gross margin improved to 74% from 72% year-over-year.
Increased R&D spend to accelerate AI and platform enhancements, with potential strategic M&A considered to enter adjacent markets.
